map.输入斜面倾角、摩擦系数与重力，计算物体沿斜面下滑的加速度，用于力学教学与斜面运动: Enter the incline angle, friction coefficient and gravity to compute the acceleration of an object sliding down the incline; used for mechanics teaching and inclined plane motion analysis.
map.a = g(sinθ − μcosθ)。 θ 过小且 μ 大则不下溜。: a = g(sin theta - mu cos theta). If theta is too small and mu too large it will not slide down.
map.考虑摩擦的斜面下滑加速度。: Downward acceleration on an incline with friction.
map.斜面下滑：录入倾角与摩擦系数，求加速度，判断物体是否加速下滑（sinθ>μcos: Sliding down an incline: enter the incline angle and the friction coefficient to get the acceleration and judge whether the object accelerates downward (sin theta > mu cos theta).

map.物体一定下滑吗？: Does the object always slide down?
map.当 sinθ>μcosθ（即 tanθ>μ）才加速下滑；否则静止或需外力。结果按: It accelerates down the slope only when sin theta > mu cos theta (that is, tan theta > mu); otherwise it stays at rest or needs an external force. Results are computed in real time from standard mechanics formulas for physics learning, homework calculation and engineering estimation; for safety or actual engineering follow professional standards and measured data.
map.μ=0 时 a=g sinθ，即沿斜面分量决定加速度，与质量无关。结果按标准力学: When mu = 0, a = g sin theta, so the component along the incline determines the acceleration, independent of mass. Results are computed in real time from standard mechanics formulas for physics learning, homework calculation and engineering estimation; for safety or actual engineering follow professional standards and measured data.
map.理想斜面（无滚动）加速度与质量无关；若考虑转动惯量（滚动）则略降。结果按标准力学: For an ideal incline (without rolling) the acceleration is independent of mass; if the moment of inertia (rolling) is considered it is slightly lower.
